svg.text: THE BODY, ONE STAGE AT A TIME
READ LEFT TO RIGHT, THEN DOWN
5. noweb expansion; the text before the reference repeats
7. trim: leading and trailing whitespace goes, but see -i at right
only whole leading blank lines go,
and the indent of the line below stays
Order is observable: unescaping before the strip means an escaped line is measured at its real indentation.
The -i switch turns off three things at once, both strips and the leading half of the trim.
The referenced body arrives already dedented, which is why the second strip finds nothing to remove.
